notes.body:
https://www.iana.org/assignments/enterprise-numbers/enterprise-numbers

The original was registered with double-quotes (sigh):

```
64587
  "VPG Laserone" LLC
    Konstantin Kichaev
      kkichaev&vpglaserone.ru
```

There's a few other existing entries with that. Doubling the double-quotes has the effect of removing them, I suppose we could escape them instead or eliminate then. @martin.r.mathieson ?
will try to look later on today
enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
